widget.instructions: Drag a vector's tip, or select it and type its size and direction in Precise controls.

stem: A bus travels {{d}} km along a straight road towards the north.
Which of these quantities about the trip is a vector?

args.text: Speed: only a size. Turning the arrow doesn't change it.

hints.text: A vector needs both a size and a direction to describe it.
Ask: does saying 'north' change the meaning of this quantity?
Only one of the options has a direction attached.

scalar-vector-confusion.text: Speed has a size but no direction: it is a scalar.

generic.text: Vectors have direction as well as size.

workedSolution.text: Displacement has a size and a direction ({{d}} km north): a vector.
Speed, time and mass have only sizes: they are scalars.

scalar-vector-confusion.front: Which needs a direction: speed or displacement?
scalar-vector-confusion.back: Displacement (a vector). Speed, mass and time are scalars.

generic.front: Scalar or vector: displacement, speed, mass, time?
generic.back: Displacement is a vector; speed, mass and time are scalars.

accessibility.altText: An arrow pointing north representing the bus's displacement.
accessibility.nonDragAlternative: Choose an answer with the radio buttons.
